# MLOps & LLMOps — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Run models and LLM apps in production with versioning
- monitoring
- rollback and retraining triggers
- Manage prompts
- embeddings and indexes as versioned artefacts

## The sentences to remember

1. **Model lifecycle: registry, gated promotion, blue/green, retirement** — “If you cannot say which version answered a customer last Tuesday, you do not have MLOps yet.”
2. **LLMOps: version the whole RAG stack — prompt, embeddings, index, model** — “In LLM systems the model is the smallest part of the version. Pin everything that can change an answer.”
3. **Monitoring: drift, quality, cost, SLOs — and the runbook** — “Dashboards are for Monday morning. Alerts are for 2 a.m. Every alert needs a name next to it and a first step.”
4. **Platform patterns: a model gateway with routing, caching, budgets and cost attribution** — “One door to the models gives you one place to log, one place to cap and one place to switch provider.”
